settings.title: Company assets settings
settings.noticeDaysNote: Default notice for the deadlines the module records in the shared deadline schedule.
settings.notificationsNote: When off, the module sends no notifications or reminders. Each user chooses how to receive them from the notification preferences.
settings.bookingsNote: Bookings need no approval; 0 = no limit.

vehicleList.title: Company vehicles
vehicleList.confirmDelete: Delete vehicle {{targa}} with its assignments, deadlines, costs and fines?

vehicleEdit.title: Vehicle
vehicleEdit.contractNote: The expiry of the rental or leasing contract goes into the shared deadline schedule.
vehicleEdit.fringeNote: The fringe benefit is 15,000 conventional km times the ACI cost per km, with the assignment's percentage (from emissions: up to 60 g/km 25%, up to 160 30%, up to 190 50%, above 60%). The payroll export stays in Attendance.
vehicleEdit.assignmentNote: Each assignment creates or updates the employee's car used by Attendance expense reports for mileage reimbursements.

vehicleItem.fringeNote: Leave 0 to use the percentage from the vehicle's emissions ({{co2}} g/km).
vehicleItem.carNote: The employee's car with this reimbursement is used by Attendance expense reports.
vehicleItem.deadlineNote: The deadline goes into the shared deadline schedule; entering the date it was done closes it.
vehicleItem.driverAuto: From the assignment on the offence date
vehicleItem.fineNote: Without a driver, whoever had the vehicle on the offence date is proposed. The notice to the driver is sent from the list of fines.

mine.title: My resources
mine.fringeNote: Fringe benefit for the current year, for information only: payroll computes the value on the payslip.
mine.goodsNote: Reports to confirm open in the acknowledgements page.

goodsList.title: Company items
goodsList.noReturns: No items or vehicles to return
goodsList.returnNote: Items and vehicles still held by employees with a termination date. Every night the administrators are notified of new terminations within the notice period and the return goes into the deadline schedule; Check now runs it immediately.
goodsList.confirmDelete: Delete item {{nome}} with its delivery history?

goodEdit.title: Item
goodEdit.deliveriesNote: On delivery and return the employee receives the report to confirm (with Document management active, to sign).
goodEdit.warrantyNote: The warranty expiry goes into the shared deadline schedule.
goodEdit.confirmDeleteAssignment: Cancel this delivery? Reports not yet confirmed are withdrawn.

goodItem.deliveryNote: The employee receives the delivery report to confirm in the acknowledgements (with Document management active, to sign). Without a user only the delivery is recorded.
goodItem.returnNote: The employee receives the return report; any deadline for the return on termination is closed.

resourceList.title: Bookable resources
resourceList.confirmDelete: Delete resource {{nome}} with its booking history?

resourceEdit.title: Bookable resource
resourceEdit.poolNote: You can choose the fleet vehicles with "pool" use.
resourceEdit.approvalNote: With approval, users' bookings stay pending until an administrator approves them in Requests to approve; administrators' bookings are confirmed immediately.

booking.title: Bookings
booking.cancelRequestWithdrawn: Cancellation request withdrawn: the booking stays approved.
booking.cancelRequestSent: Cancellation request sent: the booking stays valid until an administrator approves it.
booking.note: Your bookings also appear in your personal calendar (Calendar button).

bookingEdit.title: Booking
bookingEdit.limits: Maximum length {{ore}} hours, at most {{giorni}} days in advance. A resource already booked at that time cannot be booked.
bookingEdit.pending: Request sent: awaiting approval by an administrator.

home.chiusuraTitolo: No more spreadsheets for cars and equipment
home.chiusuraTesto: Register your company and try company asset management with your employees.

features.sottotitolo: Everything you need to manage the company's vehicles, equipment and spaces: who has them, when they expire, who books them.

vocale.title: Voice commands and chat
vocale.text: Ask the assistant what you have been given, which resources are free, or book a room, by voice or in writing.

dettaglio.intro: The assistant carries out the most common company asset tasks without going through the menu: speak into the microphone or type in the chat, in your own words.
punti: Book a desk, a meeting room or a pool car by giving the day and time
Cancel one of your bookings
Ask for your bookings and the resources free in a time slot
Ask which equipment and vehicle you have been given
For managers: fleet deadlines overdue or coming up
Opens a vehicle or equipment record, or the page you need
Shows a summary and asks for confirmation before saving

flotta.title: Fleet
flotta.text: Vehicles, assignment to employees and fringe benefits, linked to the mileage refunds in Attendance.

dettaglio.intro: For whoever manages company vehicles: records, assignments and fringe benefits, linked to expense claims in Attendance.
punti: Vehicles with plate, make, model, fuel and ownership: owned, rented or leased
Assigned to an employee or in a bookable pool
Each assignment updates the employee's car used for mileage refunds
Fringe benefit worked out from the ACI cost per km and emissions
Employees see their assigned vehicle and the year's fringe benefit
Disposed vehicles hidden from the list but kept

scadenzeVeicoli.title: Vehicle deadlines
scadenzeVeicoli.text: Road tax, insurance, inspection, servicing and rental or leasing contracts in the deadline schedule.

dettaglio.intro: Each vehicle's deadlines go into the shared schedule, with the notice period chosen in the settings.
punti: Road tax, insurance, inspection, servicing and other deadlines
A deadline closes when the date it was done is entered
Rental or leasing contract with supplier, monthly fee and included km
Contract expiry in the deadline schedule
Widget with fleet deadlines overdue or coming up

multe.title: Fines and costs
multe.text: The driver is found from the assignment period and is notified of the fine.

dettaglio.intro: To record each vehicle's fines and costs and know who was driving on the day of the offence.
punti: Fine with date and time, ticket number, place and amount
Driver suggested from whoever had the vehicle on the day
Fine sent to the driver from the list
Status: to notify, notified, paid or disputed
Costs by type, from fuel to tolls, with the yearly total
Employees see their fines in "My resources"

beni.title: Assigned equipment
beni.text: PCs, phones, badges and tools with categories and warranty expiry.

dettaglio.intro: The inventory of equipment given to employees, so you always know what you have, who holds it and when the warranty ends.
punti: Equipment categories set by the company
Inventory code, make and model, serial number, purchase and value
Status: available, handed over, under repair or disposed
Warranty end in the shared deadline schedule
Handover history for each item

consegne.title: Handover and return
consegne.text: A signed report on handover and return; on termination, the list of what must be given back.

dettaglio.intro: Every handover and return has its report confirmed by the employee; on termination you know what must come back.
punti: Handover and return reports to confirm in the acknowledgements
With Document Management active, the report is signed
Condition of the item noted on return
List of equipment and vehicles still held by leaving employees
Nightly check with a notice to administrators and the return in the schedule
Employees see what they hold and the reports to confirm

prenotazioni.title: Bookings
prenotazioni.text: Desks, meeting rooms and pool cars without overlaps, also in your personal calendar.

dettaglio.intro: To book desks, meeting rooms and pool cars on your own, with no double bookings on the same resource.
punti: Bookable resources by type, with the number of seats
Weekly view, filtered by resource or by your own bookings
A resource already booked for that time cannot be booked again
Maximum length and advance booking set in the settings
Optional administrator approval for each resource
Bookings also shown in your personal calendar and widget

mieRisorse.title: My resources
mieRisorse.text: Each employee sees their vehicle, equipment held, fines, bookings and reports to confirm on one page.

dettaglio.intro: A personal page to know what the company has given you, without asking the office.
punti: Assigned vehicle and the year's fringe benefit
Equipment held with inventory code and handover date
Fines in your name with status and amount
Upcoming bookings of desks, rooms and cars
Handover and return reports to confirm

pricing.sottotitolo: Start for free: choose a plan when you are ready, all features are included.

inclusi.prenotazioni: Bookings of desks, rooms and cars

pricing.nota: Prices exclude VAT. No commitment: cancel whenever you want.

installare.domanda: Do employees need to install anything?
installare.risposta: No: they book, see their resources and confirm reports from the browser on their phone or computer.

scadenze.domanda: How am I notified of deadlines?
scadenze.risposta: Road tax, insurance, inspection, contracts and warranties go into the shared schedule, with the notice period chosen in the settings and notifications to administrators.

presenze.domanda: Does it connect to attendance tracking?
presenze.risposta: Yes: if you also use Attendance, the assigned vehicle becomes the car used for mileage refunds in expense claims.

consulente.domanda: I am a consultant: can I manage several companies?
consulente.risposta: Yes: with the plans for firms you manage your client companies and act on their behalf when needed.

about.sottotitolo: We have been working for years alongside HR offices, administrations and companies.
about.paragrafo1: We know first-hand the work of those who manage company cars and equipment: spreadsheets to update, deadlines remembered at the last minute, items nobody knows who holds.
about.paragrafo2: {{siteName}} was created to take this work away: every resource has an owner, deadlines arrive on their own and employees see what they hold.

semplice.title: Simple for employees
semplice.text: Booking a room or confirming a report takes a few seconds.

ordinato.title: Orderly for administration
ordinato.text: Assignments, handovers and costs always tracked.

vicino.title: Close to those who manage
vicino.text: Features designed with people who look after fleets and inventories every day.

register.condizioni: I accept the terms of service and the privacy policy
register.inviata: We have sent you an email with a link to activate your account: open it and company assets will be ready right away.
